newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chiwan Petroleum 96 net profit 55mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Chiwan Petroleum 96 net profit 55mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Chiwan Petroleum Supply Base Co Ltd registered net profit of 54.69 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in an announcement after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.24 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 101.38 million yuan, the exchange notice said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.

The company posted net profit of US$8.17 million on turnover of US$12.26 million on Chinese accounting standards, according to the firm's 1995 annual report. The report gave no figures based on international standards.
The firm has proposed a cash dividend of US$0.02 per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoon, it said.
